"""Toolformer loss-filter implementation."""

import numpy as np

def filter_api_calls(with_result, call_only, no_call, tau_filter):
    # Validation
    for name, arr in [("with_result", with_result), ("call_only", call_only), ("no_call", no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D array")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if not (with_result.shape == call_only.shape == no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, horizon = with_result.shape
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    loss_with = -np.dot(with_result, weights)
    loss_call = -np.dot(call_only, weights)
    loss_no = -np.dot(no_call, weights)
    improvement_no = loss_no - loss_with
    improvement_call = loss_call - loss_with
    margin = np.minimum(improvement_no, improvement_call)
    keep = margin > tau_filter
    return keep, margin

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np


def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")

import numpy as np

def filter_api_calls(with_result, call_only, no_call, tau_filter):
    # Validation
    for name, arr in [("with_result", with_result), ("call_only", call_only), ("no_call", no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D array")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if not (with_result.shape == call_only.shape == no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, horizon = with_result.shape
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    loss_with = -np.dot(with_result, weights)
    loss_call = -np.dot(call_only, weights)
    loss_no = -np.dot(no_call, weights)
    improvement_no = loss_no - loss_with
    improvement_call = loss_call - loss_with
    margin = np.minimum(improvement_no, improvement_call)
    keep = margin > tau_filter
    return keep, margin
